headline: Call record reveals Obaidul Quader ordered attacks on students
summary: Prosecution submits audio evidence to the International Crimes Tribunal showing the former minister urging Chhatra League president to attack protesters during the July uprising.
details: The prosecution has submitted a call record as evidence in a case regarding crimes against humanity during the July mass uprising. The recording is allegedly between former Road Transport and Bridges Minister Obaidul Quader and Chhatra League president Saddam Hossain.
tweet:
“Why don't you attack them?”

A call record submitted to the tribunal reveals Obaidul Quader urging attacks on students during the July uprising. #Bangladesh #Justice #JulyUprising
source: Jamuna TV, Prothom Alo, Somoy News

headline: 471 more hospitalised with dengue in 24 hours
summary: Total cases this year have reached 17,880, with over 1,200 patients currently receiving treatment across the country.
details: At least 471 dengue patients were hospitalised in the 24 hours leading up to 8:00 am today.
This sudden surge brings the total number of dengue cases recorded this year to 17,880.
Currently, 1,218 patients are undergoing treatment at various hospitals across the country.
